When they question you in the midst of the Saṅgha, if it is present say it is present; if absent, say it is absent. Do not be flustered, do not be embarrassed. They will question you thus: do you have afflictions of these kinds?

checks.issue: ⚠ THIS IS THE FULL LIST THAT PAGE 295 ABBREVIATES WITH ฯลฯ. There the questioning is printed as 'กุฏฐัง ฯลฯ' and the answers as 'นัตถิ ภันเต ฯลฯ'; here, in the REHEARSAL, the book prints all fifteen questions and their answers in full. So the text page 295 omits is not lost — it is on 293-294, and anyone completing 295 should take it from here rather than from outside the book.

TWO COLUMNS, AND EACH CELL IS ITS OWN VERSE — the treatment page 304 established. The left column holds a numbered question and the right its answer, under the headers ถาม and ตอบ, so the columns carry separate utterances by different speakers rather than one line split across a gutter. The headers themselves are entered as two Thai-only verses, because they are printed lines the sheet shows.

THE LIST RESTARTS ITS NUMBERING THREE TIMES — 1-5 for the afflictions, then 1-8 for the qualifications, then 1-2 for name and preceptor. printed_number follows the book and therefore repeats; the app's own verse count runs straight through, which is exactly what the two fields are kept apart for.
